mentions.heading: Dependence on five largest customers
mentions.detail: Five largest customers ~42% of 2025 net sales; GM, Ford, Stellantis among largest
mentions.quote: Our five largest customers accounted for approximately 42% of our total net sales for the year ended December 31, 2025. Accordingly, our revenues may be adversely affected by decreases in any of their businesses or market share.

mentions.heading: Dependence on five largest customers
mentions.detail: Worldwide semiconductor shortage cut vehicle production, hurting 2023 results
mentions.quote: For instance, the worldwide semiconductor shortage adversely impacted the automotive industry in recent years resulting in reduced vehicle production schedules and sales from historical levels, which adversely impacted our financial condition, operating results and cash flows for portions of the year ended December 31, 2023.

mentions.heading: Dependence on five largest customers
mentions.detail: UAW strikes at GM, Ford, Stellantis Sept 2023 lasting over six weeks hurt 2023 results
mentions.quote: In addition, certain United Automobile, Aerospace and Agricultural Implement Workers of America (“UAW”) represented employees at GM, Ford Motor Company (“Ford”) and Stellantis N.V. (“Stellantis”) initiated labor strikes in September 2023, lasting more than six weeks in duration.

mentions.heading: We may not realize sales represented by awarded business.
mentions.detail: Awarded business based on projected volumes; customers don't guarantee volumes and can terminate without penalty
mentions.quote: Our customers generally do not guarantee volumes. In addition, awarded business may include business under arrangements that our customers have the right to terminate without penalty.

mentions.heading: Continued pricing pressures, OEM cost reduction initiatives and re-sourcing may lower margins
mentions.detail: Supply agreements require annual price step-downs of 1-3%; Tier I supplier facing OEM leverage
mentions.quote: Our customer supply agreements generally require step-downs in component pricing over the period of production, typically one to three percent per year.

mentions.heading: Requirements contracts expose revenues to decline in OEM production
mentions.detail: OEMs buy requirements without minimums; contracts 1 year to model life (3-7 years), terminable for convenience
mentions.quote: In most instances our OEM customers agree to purchase their requirements for specific products but are not required to purchase any minimum amount of products from us.
